## Landing gate (not implementation completion)
After all implementation/integration steps, review one coherent PR for duplication and boundary leakage. Confirm canonical reads and history share one policy and projection; only Channels compares source locators; no new attachment-specific Engine event, generic invoke, tool, ACL, migration or skip-permission workaround. Verify all seven module changes and tests satisfy parent contract; update Beadwork with actual validation evidence and exceptions.
Follow authoritative docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md validation lifecycle: isolated tests and mix q per issue; approved PR review followed by dedicated coverage-upper phase; repeat checks after coverage/review changes; final mix precommit against final tree before requesting final human approval. No numerical target invented here; no skipped failing assertions. Do not commit/push/merge without separate authorization. Keep issues open until implementation is actually validated by implementing agent.

Planning only: leave open; implementation has not started. Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md validation lifecycle, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/action-reuse.md and relevant Engine/Channels/materialization guides. Write tests before implementation; reuse existing helpers rather than duplicate permission, projection or source-validation logic. No migration, new tool, attachment ACL, provider membership query, generic invoke, or attachment-specific Engine event.


Validation evidence: mix q passes, git diff --check clean. First mix precommit run had one unrelated :eaddrinuse HTTP-stub listener failure in test/zaq/agent/retrieval_coverage_test.exs:106; unchanged isolated rerun passed. Full repeat mix precommit PASSED: 48 doctests, 266 properties, 11149 tests, zero failures, 1 skipped, 125 excluded; seed 207025. Self-review confirms one shared transcript gate/projection, no new Engine event, source matching confined to Channels, unchanged provider fetch path. No commit/push/PR authorized or performed. Pending lifecycle: PR review approval and then required dedicated coverage-upper phase; repeat required gates if review/coverage changes code. Leave this task and parent open until landing lifecycle is complete.

User authorized commit and push. Committed d3654ce01 (fix(channels): inherit transcript permissions for shared attachments) and pushed fix/shared-channel-attachments to origin with upstream tracking. Commit and push hooks passed. PR has not been created; review/post-review coverage remain pending.

Rebase conflicts resolved against pinned main ebf82e6; shared message_projection and present_messages retain author/timestamp inputs, batched MessageAuthor projection, private-field sanitation, exact placement and current permission checks. Both conflict test sets retained plus new combined provider/recorded-time and exact/list equality regression. Reuse: private internal presentation helper, no new Action. mix q passed; focused 13 suites: 312 tests + 14 properties, zero failures. Detached HEAD requires MIX_TEST_PARTITION=fix_shared_channel_attachments to select original isolated branch test DB; initial default DB had stale admitted_at schema. Full precommit repeat completed with 9949 tests, 199 properties, 17 doctests and six PostgreSQL deadlocks in unchanged PeoplePermissionsTest, PersonOAuthCallbackTest and OAuthAttemptsTest (seed 430573); those three suites pass together isolated: 45 tests + 4 properties. Full validation remains BLOCKED; no existing tests weakened. User requested uncommitted review: rebase remains PAUSED, resolutions staged, HEAD at main, branch/remote still d3654ce, backup/shared-attachments-before-rebase-d3654ce preserved. No rebase --continue, commit or push. Next: review cached diff, address full-suite deadlock gate, then only with authorization continue rebase and force-with-lease pinned remote d3654ce0181e01c1c6319c99a4d413b3a2519746. Plan steps 1-3 ticked; validation/publish pending.
